programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: In 1959 England, a psychiatrist's wife (Natasha Richardson) engages in a doomed relationship with an unstable patient (Marton Csokas). An overheated exercise directed by David Mackenzie. Ian McKellen, Hugh Bonneville.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: A triumphant Cinderella story about the crowd-pleasing Depression-era thoroughbred Seabiscuit. Together, Seabiscuit's downtrodden jockey, wizened trainer and entrepreneurial owner lead the horse to several victories that helped to inspire a Americans during the downtrodden 1930s.

programme.title: The Perfect Game
programme.desc: Buy some peanuts, Cracker Jack and tissues for this warmhearted sports saga based on the true story of a ragtag baseball team from Monterrey, Mexico, that became the first non-U.S. squad to win the Little League World Series in 1957. Clifton Collins Jr., Cheech Marin, Louis Gossett Jr., Bruce McGill, David Koechner. Directed by William Dear. Screenwriter W. William Winokur adapted his book of the same name.

programme.title: North of Normal
programme.desc: In the 1970s, the experiences of a little girl, who grows up with her young mother in the commune founded by her hippie grandparents.

programme.title: The Virgin Suicides
programme.desc: A moody memory piece about five doomed teenage sisters in 1970s suburbia.

programme.title: 45 Years
programme.desc: An ageing couple's marriage is challenged when the body of the husband's ex-fiancée is discovered, more than 50 years after she disappeared during a holiday in Switzerland.

programme.title: In a Relationship
programme.desc: This romantic comedy satirizes L.A. dating culture by juxtaposing two millennial couples at different relationship stages. Each couple explores different romantic challenges, romantic expectations, and relationship dynamics throughout the summer of 2016.

programme.title: Alone in Berlin
programme.desc: After the death of their only son, a German couple begin to send postcards urging people to stand against Adolph Hitler and the Nazis. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: At an exclusive political summit, seven world leaders get hopelessly lost in misty woods while drafting a crisis statement. As night falls, their predicament turns from comedic to horrific, with surreal encounters testing their already questionable leadership abilities and exposing the absurdity of power.

programme.title: The Assistant
programme.desc: A man deals with working as a helper for an insufferable social-media celebrity.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: A recent divorcee becomes entangled in a mystery involving her former husband and his new family.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman commits a horrific act while taking an anti-anxiety drug, which leads to a criminal investigation of her therapist that digs up possible evidence of past indiscretions.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: At a middle-of-nowhere truck stop in Arizona, lives will collide as a traveling knife salesman gets caught up in a hostage situation. A pair of violent bank robbers are stranded with the salesman waiting for a gas truck. When the town's residents gather in the local diner, things get a little crazy as they realize the robbers are there, along with the money they stole.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Brandon Lee's final film is a dark, eerie and violent tale of a murdered rock star who returns from the dead, seeking revenge against his killers. Fast-paced action film with superb set design and a hard-rock soundtrack.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Mel Brooks' send-up of Hollywood Westerns.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: A retired jewel thief will be arrested unless he can trap the copycat burglar who has taken up serial-stealing on the French Riviera.

programme.title: The Parallax View
programme.desc: Warren Beatty as a reporter who sees unlikely coincidence in the deaths of witnesses to a political assassination. Rintels: Hume Cronyn. Tucker: William Daniels. Jack: Walter McGinn. Lee: Paula Prentiss. Sheriff: Kelly Thordsen. Taut direction by Alan J. Pakula.

programme.title: Dark Asset
programme.desc: When he glimpses a beautiful and enigmatic young woman from across the bar, a smooth and charming man attempts to flirt with her by telling her a story. As he spins his yarn of double agents, experimental microchip technology, and an unhinged military science organization on his trail in startling detail, the woman begins to wonder how much of the tale is fiction and how much is fact.

programme.title: All the World is Sleeping
programme.desc: As an engaged couple plans their dream wedding, the groom is excited but doesn't inform his friends he's getting married. Confused by his secrecy, they hatch a plan to find out what he's hiding. Meanwhile, the bride seems withdrawn, and her groom starts worrying if this relationship is meant to be.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After young teenager Susie Salmon is murdered, she watches over her grieving parents, as well as her unapprehended killer, from a heaven of her own creation. Susie must come to terms with her own death, while sharing the pain her father and mother are working through.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: Agatha Christie classic features detective Hercule Poirot attempting to solve a murder on a train.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Wildly inept Los Angeles cop Frank Drebin tries to foil an assassination. Inspired by the 1982 TV series.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: Keenen Ivory Wayans directed and Shawn and Marlon Wayans star in this raunchy spoof of teen horror films. It centres on a bumbling killer stalking clueless high-school students.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: A demented professor leads a group of students to haunted-house scares by tricking them into thinking they are participating for a school project.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: With the world ravaged by an incurable viral outbreak and most of mankind dead, an ex FBI agent finds himself responsible for the safeguarding of a young woman who has rare immunity to the deadly disease. However, a nefarious gang leader will stop at nothing to kidnap the woman and have access to her biological immunity.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: While grappling with her seemingly insurmountable grief, a young woman named Vanessa embarks on a retreat in search of some solace. However, she soon discovers that the lines between different realities have begun to blur, and she finds herself caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Following his son's death at the hands of the police, criminal Ron Whitlock embarks on a quest for revenge. Assembling a team of mercenaries in a plot to overthrow the government, Whitlock seizes power at a government-owned nuclear power plant, ultimately threatening the destruction of a nearby town until a retired Army ranger vows to face Whitlock head-on.

programme.title: Mona Lisa and the Blood Moon
programme.desc: Having lived her life in a psychiatric facility, a young girl with extraordinary abilities vows to make her own way in the world. Upon her escape, she explores New Orleans, encountering a host of new experiences and people that alter her perspective on her sheltered, unusual life.

programme.title: The Parallax View
programme.desc: Warren Beatty as a reporter who sees unlikely coincidence in the deaths of witnesses to a political assassination. Rintels: Hume Cronyn. Tucker: William Daniels. Jack: Walter McGinn. Lee: Paula Prentiss. Sheriff: Kelly Thordsen. Taut direction by Alan J. Pakula.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: This historical drama fictionalizes the story of Greville Wynne, a British electrical engineer and businessman turned M16 agent who relays crucial intelligence about the Soviet nuclear program to the CIA. With the help of his Russian informant, Oleg Penkovsky (a.k.a. Ironbark), he aids the Western Bloc in defusing the Cuban missile crisis of 1962.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Denzel Washington directed and stars in this inspiring and uplifting true story, which chronicles the rise of a debate team at a small all-black college in Texas that went on to challenge Harvard in the 1930s.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: A government agent goes on the run from his own agency, in an effort to try and clear his name.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An explorer and his sidekick search for treasure and help a doctor contain a plague in Africa.

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: A woman discovers that her mother was undergoing an exorcism when she committed three murders, and she travels to Italy with a documentary crew to uncover the full truth of what happened.

programme.title: Area 51
programme.desc: Found-footage shocker about a group of amateur researchers who uncover horrific secrets when they infiltrate Area 51, the government facility alleged to contain aliens.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: "Scream" director Wes Craven and writer Kevin Williamson reunite for this bloodcurdling chiller. It's the story of siblings (Christina Ricci, Jesse Eisenberg) who are bitten by a mysterious beast, then gradually turn into werewolves. Can they break the deadly curse? Scott Baio and Craig Kilborn have cameos. Joshua Jackson, Portia de Rossi, Shannon Elizabeth, Mya, Kristina Anapau.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Deep in the eerie swamps of southern Louisiana, teens encounter an evil force while trying to uncover the truth behind a friend's mysterious death. Agnes Bruckner leads a sizzling young cast in this fright-filled thriller. Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer. Directed by Jim Gillespie.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Ex-con Arkin (Josh Stewart) matches wits with a masked serial killer known as "The Collector" in this suspenseful shocker. Arkin decides to rob a country manor but finds that its occupants have been taken hostage inside their home by "The Collector." Now Arkin is the family's only hope for survival as he does battle with the sadist and his lethal booby traps. Directed by Marcus Dunstan.

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

programme.title: Lions for Lambs
programme.desc: A powerhouse cast led by Robert Redford, Meryl Streep and Tom Cruise stars in this compelling examination of the U.S. war on terror, intercutting the stories of a liberal professor, a hawkish U.S. senator and a skeptical journalist. Michael Pena, Andrew Garfield, Peter Berg, Kevin Dunn.

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: A Vietnam War veteran struggles with flashbacks and hallucinations. With the help of his new bride, he fights to keep sane while his brain fluctuates between reality and delusion.

programme.title: Mommie Dearest
programme.desc: Based on Christina Crawford's memoirs about her Hollywood upbringing and her mother Joan Crawford's hang-ups, the film depicts the abuse and trauma suffered by Christina.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs take an unexpected trip through a portal and land in the middle of New York City, and they must find their way home before their archnemesis Gargamel tracks them down.

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: Papa Smurf and the gang race to Paris to rescue Smurfette from the evil clutches of Gargamel, who seeks to harness the essence of the Smurfs after creating a race of rascally creatures called the Naughties.

programme.title: Alone in Berlin
programme.desc: After the death of their only son, a German couple begin to send postcards urging people to stand against Adolph Hitler and the Nazis. Based on a true story.

programme.title: A Time to Kill
programme.desc: An adaptation of John Grisham's first novel that depicts the story of how a white lawyer defends a black man who is on trial for killing his daughter's rapists in a racially divided Mississippi town.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
